Container.Name: tailscale-sidecar
Container.Overview: Generic Tailscale sidecar container. Joins your Tailscale network and provides overlay-network access for a paired service container that shares its network namespace. **You MUST rename this container per service before deploying** (e.g., tailscale-mcpmemory). Deploying two with the default name and state path will collide.
Container.Description:
Generic Tailscale sidecar for the WireSpeed MCP stack. This container joins your Tailscale network and provides overlay-network access. A paired service container (mcp-memory, filesystem-mcp, etc.) shares this container's network namespace via --network=container:this-container-name.
============================================================ CRITICAL: RENAME BEFORE DEPLOYMENT ============================================================ This template ships with the GENERIC default name `tailscale-sidecar` and the GENERIC default state path `/mnt/user/appdata/tailscale-sidecar/`. If you deploy two services using these defaults without renaming, BOTH will try to claim the same Tailscale node identity and write to the same state directory. The second deployment will fail or overwrite the first.
Per service: 1. Rename the container from `tailscale-sidecar` to a service-specific name (e.g., `tailscale-mcpmemory`, `tailscale-filesystem-mcp`, `tailscale-unraidmcp`). 2. Rename the host state path to match (e.g., `/mnt/user/appdata/tailscale-mcpmemory/`). 3. Set TS_HOSTNAME to your desired Tailscale hostname. 4. Generate a fresh, single-use auth key for THIS service and paste into TS_AUTHKEY. ============================================================
BEFORE DEPLOYING: 1. Generate a Tailscale auth key at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys (Reusable: no, Ephemeral: no, Expiration: 90 days) 2. Rename the container and state path per the warning above. 3. Set TS_HOSTNAME. 4. Paste your auth key into TS_AUTHKEY.
AFTER FIRST BOOT: - The auth key is consumed on first boot. The node persists via the state directory. - In the Tailscale admin console, **disable key expiry** on this device (service accounts that never refresh credentials will disconnect at the 180-day mark if key expiry remains enabled). - If you used a free-tier trial, downgrade explicitly in the admin console before or shortly after trial end. Tailscale does not auto-downgrade.

Config.Name: Tailscale State
Config.Description: Persistent Tailscale state. RENAME the host path to match your renamed container (e.g., /mnt/user/appdata/tailscale-mcpmemory/). Two sidecars sharing this path will collide.

Config.Name: Tailscale Auth Key
Config.Description: One-time auth key from Tailscale admin console. Consumed on first boot. Generate per-service; do not reuse across deployments.

Config.Name: Tailscale Hostname
Config.Description: Hostname on your Tailscale network. Use something descriptive (e.g., mcp-memory, filesystem-mcp). This is the name you will see in the Tailscale admin console.

Config.Name: Userspace Mode
Config.Description: Run Tailscale in userspace networking mode. Recommended for Docker.

Config.Name: Auth Once
Config.Description: Authenticate once, then persist via state directory. Recommended.

Config.Name: State Directory
Config.Description: Internal path for Tailscale state. Must match the volume mount target.

Config.Name: Extra Args
Config.Description: Additional Tailscale CLI arguments. Usually leave empty.
